estimand: Window-level presence of an admitted same-mint buy in first eight slots and admitted sell in last eight slots in the frozen Rust-admitted event tape, separately per epoch-half stratum. Not all actual Pump trades.
certification_interpretation: The accepted negative gate deliberately withholds some fully observed tape zeros when existing evidence could hide non-admitted trades. Keep this conservative coarsening; do not relabel the estimand market-wide. The resulting identification interval can be wider than the sharp interval for the admitted tape.
unit: One fixed 16-slot window; different atomic packages for the two halves; one positive window irrespective of number of matched mints.

label_precedence.label: POSITIVE
label_precedence.requires: At least one original successful admitted buy fact in [start,start+8) and sell fact in [start+8,start+16), same reported mint, different source-bound packages; valid sample/source/fact/parent/instruction/event links.
label_precedence.coverage: Uncertainty elsewhere cannot negate a valid existential witness. Invalid identity or witness is not rescued by apparent pair counts.

label_precedence.label: NEGATIVE_CERTIFIED
label_precedence.requires: No admitted pair after complete verified window processing, with no potentially hiding successful/unknown-parent rejected, unexplained or unbound event-layout instruction and no missing program/location/CPI context under the unchanged coverage rule.
label_precedence.not_enough: An empty result, no detected gap, a generic WRONG_DISCRIMINATOR probe, index absence or failed transaction alone cannot establish this label.

label_precedence.label: UNKNOWN
label_precedence.requires: All other cases without a valid positive witness; preserve every assigned window and explicit reason.

separate_outcomes.engineering: Integrity/resource/execution failures remain failures, not hypothesis evidence; stop for the applicable decision. Never silently replace a window.
separate_outcomes.statistical: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE if the fixed final width exceeds 0.50 or required validity/contamination gates fail. No such final outcome is assigned now.
separate_outcomes.hypothesis: This precision assessment has no null/effect threshold and performs no baseline test, market-edge falsification, training or profitability assessment.

censoring_and_time: No outside halo. First/last eight slots define the fixed within-window question; later trades are not chased. Full lifecycle is censored/unknown. Chain positions define halves; acquisition/processing/report clocks are excluded. Historical availability, actionability, latency and execution opportunity remain UNAVAILABLE.

denominators.unknowns: Remain in fixed denominator; never imputed or dropped
denominators.already_inspected_development: Four positive witnesses available; not untouched holdout; no population estimate claimed

final_rule.source_and_semantic_gates: Valid immutable source/sample/admission bindings for every known label; unchanged fixed design; no contaminated evaluation. Publish engineering status separately.
final_rule.sufficient_scope: Only the bounded event-tape estimate, conditional on sampling assumptions and all validity gates; not full B7/B8 or Research Ready
final_rule.no_optional_stopping: No interim sufficiency calculation, favorable-outcome extension, replacement, threshold/horizon change or repeated final evaluation

assumptions: Preregistered deterministic SHA256 rank modeled as uniform sampling without replacement inside each fixed finite stratum; not demonstrated randomization.
Nominal 95 percent per-stratum bound, not a simultaneous guarantee across both strata.
Fixed population binary tape outcomes under frozen decoder/protocol rules; UNKNOWN includes conservative withheld certifications.
No IID-mint or nonoverlap-implies-temporal-independence claim. Design-based finite-population interpretation is conditional on the declared sampling model.
One epoch, separate earlier/later populations, 32-slot embargo and preserved exclusions. No cross-regime generalization or DEVELOPMENT-to-evaluation pooling.
freeze_artifact_required: Owner-approved method version/hash and immutable decision record before evaluation visibility
Accepted selection and cohort/rank/stage identities; no change
Exact decoder/admission/coverage/label software identities and source manifests used at execution; actual mixed producer provenance retained
Read policy and tested allowlist denying unapproved evaluation exports, aggregates, logs, errors and browser/API paths
Single final assessment boundary, contamination register, fixed n and threshold
Explicit evidence/cost limits: no prices, return, fill, actionability or fee model is supplied by this event-only question
sequence: Freeze this methodological interpretation under B7; this is not Gold/model execution.
Separately review technical shielding using DEVELOPMENT/fixtures without evaluation outcomes. Current route remains DEVELOPMENT ordinals 0-3 only.
Obtain explicit bounded execution and evaluation-visibility authority; follow unchanged stage/rank order and integrity/resource triggers. This draft grants none.
